name.zh-Hans: 一年读经计划（按圣经顺序）
name.zh-Hant: 一年讀經計劃（按聖經順序）

description.en: Read the entire Bible in 365 days in canonical order — about 3 chapters per day.
description.zh-Hans: 365天读完整本圣经，按圣经顺序排列，每天约3章。
description.zh-Hant: 365天讀完整本聖經，按聖經順序排列，每天約3章。

description.en: Read the Bible in approximate historical order over 365 days. Job is read with Genesis; the prophets are interleaved with the kings.
description.zh-Hans: 365天按大致历史顺序读完整本圣经。约伯记与创世记同读，先知书与列王相互穿插。
description.zh-Hant: 365天按大致歷史順序讀完整本聖經。約伯記與創世記同讀，先知書與列王相互穿插。

description.en: Robert M'Cheyne's 1842 calendar — 4 readings each day. Read the Old Testament once and the New Testament + Psalms twice in a year.
description.zh-Hans: 麦琴1842年读经表。每天4段，一年内读完旧约一遍、新约和诗篇两遍。
description.zh-Hant: 麥琴1842年讀經表。每天4段，一年內讀完舊約一遍、新約和詩篇兩遍。
